Help & troubleshooting#

Short answers for when a link, an upload or a live tour does not do what you expected. Start with the section that matches what you see.

A link will not open#

On a phone. Tap the link. Most links from WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and other apps open inside that app's own browser, and the scene works there too. If the page says 3D is not supported in this app, tap Open in your browser and it opens in Safari or Chrome instead.

  • If the scene asks you to tap to enter, tap it: that tap is what lets the phone go full screen and play sound.
  • On an iPhone or iPad that says Update your iPhone or iPad to iOS 17 or later, the device is too old to show 3D. Update it in Settings ▸ General ▸ Software Update, or open the link on another device.
  • Low battery mode and a hot phone make scenes slower, not broken. Give it a few seconds.

On a laptop or desktop. Use a current Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox. If the page says the browser is out of date, update it and open the link again. Work computers sometimes switch 3D graphics off in the browser; if the scene never appears on one computer but works on another, ask your IT team whether graphics acceleration is allowed.

The page says the scene is private. Its owner has limited who can open it. Ask them for a personal link (see Privacy of links).

The page says the scene is still being prepared. Keep the page open; it opens the scene by itself when it is ready.

The page says the scene has expired or cannot be loaded. Check the link is complete (copy it again, all of it). Scenes uploaded without an account are kept on a best-effort basis and can be cleared to make room; scenes saved to an account are kept until their owner deletes them. Ask whoever sent the link for a fresh one.

The browser says graphics were stopped#

After a long session, many open tabs or a large upload, a browser can stop its graphics for every page at once. You will see Your browser's graphics have stopped or Graphics stopped in this browser.

Quit the browser completely and open it again, then reopen the link. Closing the tab is not enough — the whole browser has to restart. On a Mac, use Quit (⌘Q); on Windows, close every window of that browser; on a phone, swipe the browser away in the app switcher. Nothing is lost: scenes, comments and settings are saved on our side.

If it happens again straight away, restart the computer or phone, and check that the browser and the operating system are up to date.

Slow networks#

A scene starts with a picture and gets sharper as the rest arrives, so on a slow connection you see something early and the detail fills in over the next seconds. You do not need to wait for everything before looking around.

  • Move closer to the Wi-Fi router, or switch from Wi-Fi to mobile data (or back) if one of them is weak.
  • Stay on the page: the parts already downloaded are kept, and opening the same scene again later is faster.
  • On a very slow line, larger scenes take longer to reach full detail. Nothing is wrong with the scene if it is still getting sharper.

Uploads that fail#

When an upload or a build fails, the screen tells you what happened and what to do next. Find the message here for the plain fix. Each message also has a short code, which is what plug-ins and the API report (errorInfo.code), so the code column helps if you are reading a log.

To start again: drop the file onto the upload screen or choose it, then Publish. A file that failed for a reason on our side can usually be sent again unchanged.

Something about the file#

What you seeCodeWhat to do
This file is over the upload limitfile_too_largeMake the file smaller: export textures at 2K (2048 px) and turn on compression in your exporter. The limit is shown on the upload screen.
This file is emptyempty_fileExport the model again and check it has a size before you upload it.
We can't read this file typeunsupported_formatExport as GLB (or FBX or OBJ). See What you can upload for every file type we read.
This is already a compiled Verse scenealready_compiledThis file is the result of an earlier upload. Upload the original model, or just open the scene's link.
This is an old glTF 1.0 filegltf_versionExport again as glTF 2.0 — every current 3D tool can.
This model points at files that weren't uploadedgltf_external_filesExport one self-contained file: choose "glTF Binary (.glb)", which packs the textures inside.
This file looks damaged or incompletecorrupt_fileThe file was cut off or not fully saved. Export it again and upload the fresh copy.
There is no 3D geometry in this fileno_meshesMake sure your objects are visible and selected when you export.
This model has lines or points we can't buildunsupported_geometryDelete loose lines and points, or convert them to solid objects, and export again.
This file uses a compression we don't support yetunsupported_featureExport again without that compression. Draco and meshopt compression both work.
One of the textures can't be readbad_textureSave the textures as PNG or JPEG and export again.
This capture isn't a format we can readsplat_invalidUpload the capture app's .ply or .splat export. An ordinary mesh should be exported as GLB.
This point cloud isn't a format we can readcloud_invalidUpload .ply, .las, .laz or .e57. A mesh should be exported as GLB.
This file isn't an IFC or USD we can readbim_invalidExport IFC2x3 or IFC4 from your BIM tool, or a single-file USD/USDZ.
This FBX or OBJ file isn't one we can readmodel_invalidExport FBX 2014–2020 or OBJ + MTL, and zip it together with its texture folder.
This point cloud has too many pointscloud_too_manyThin the scan out in your scanning software and upload again.
This capture has too many splatssplat_too_manyCrop or reduce the capture in your splat editor and upload again.
This zip doesn't hold a model we can readzip_invalidZip the model file itself — a .gltf with its .bin and textures, a .glb, or an .fbx / .obj with its .mtl and texture folder — and upload the .zip. A single .glb also uploads on its own.
This video is too short to build a space fromcapture_too_shortFilm for 20–60 seconds: walk slowly around the room holding the phone upright at chest height, turning to see every wall.
We need more photos of the roomcapture_too_few_photosTake 30–150 photos while walking around the room, each one overlapping the last by about half, and zip them together. Or send a 30-second video instead.
The video is too darkcapture_too_darkTurn the lights on, open the curtains, and film again — 20–40 seconds, walking slowly around the room.
The video is too blurrycapture_too_blurryFilm again more slowly, in good light, and avoid quick turns. Walking a step, pausing, then turning works well.
We couldn't work out where the camera wascapture_no_posesFilm one room in one continuous shot: move slowly, keep about 2 metres from what you film, and let each view overlap the last. Don't edit or trim the video.
We couldn't find the floorcapture_no_floorFilm again holding the phone upright at chest height, tilted slightly down so the floor is in view.
Not enough of the room came outcapture_emptyFilm the room again in one slow, steady walk around it, with the lights on.
We can't play this videocapture_unreadableSend the video straight from your phone's camera app (MP4 or MOV), without editing apps in between.
These photos are in HEIC formatcapture_heicOn the iPhone: Settings → Camera → Formats → Most Compatible, then take the photos again — or send a video of the room instead.
Room capture isn't available on this server yetcapture_unavailableTry again later, or send a finished 3D file (GLB, a splat .ply) instead.
Building your space didn't finishcapture_failedSend it again in a few minutes. If it keeps happening, we'll look into it.

The scene is too big to build#

What you seeCodeWhat to do
This scene needs more memory than our build server hasout_of_memoryUse fewer or smaller textures (2K), or split the scene into parts. Repeated objects like trees and chairs build lighter when exported as copies of one object.
This scene is beyond what one streamed scene can holdformat_limitSplit the scene into parts and upload them separately.
This scene took too long to buildcompile_timeoutSimplify the scene — fewer or smaller textures, fewer triangles — or split it into parts.
Still over your plan's limit after preparingprepared_too_largeWe already compressed the textures and meshes and the scene is still bigger than your plan takes. Upgrade your plan, choose the harder compression when offered, or export with fewer or smaller textures.
The built scene didn't pass our checksoutput_invalidSplitting the scene into smaller parts usually gets it through. If not, write to hello@ctruh.com.

Limits on how often you upload#

What you seeCodeWhat to do
You've reached the upload limit for nowrate_limitedWait a little and try again, or sign in for a higher limit.
Today's upload quota is used upquota_exceededThe allowance resets at midnight. Write to hello@ctruh.com if you need more.
This server needs an API keyauth_requiredAdd your key in the plug-in's settings, or ask whoever runs the server for one.

The connection dropped#

What you seeCodeWhat to do
The upload was interruptedupload_interruptedCheck your connection and upload again.
The upload didn't finishupload_incompleteUpload again.
This upload session expiredupload_expiredThe upload sat idle too long. Upload again.
We lost contact with the servernetworkCheck your connection. A build that had already started may still finish — try again in a minute.
We couldn't download the file from that linkurl_fetch_failedUse a direct download link and check it opens in a private browser window.
That link can't be fetchedurl_blockedThe link must be a public web address. Upload the file itself instead.
The upload request wasn't validbad_requestTry again from the upload screen. Developers: check the request against the API reference.
We can't find this buildunknown_jobUpload records expire after a while. If you have the scene's link, it still works; otherwise upload again.

Something on our side#

Nothing is wrong with your file. Wait a few minutes and upload it again; the team is alerted automatically.

What you seeCode
Our build server is out of space right nowstorage_full
The build queue is fullserver_busy
Our server didn't answerserver_unreachable
We couldn't convert this fileconvert_failed
The build stopped making progresscompile_stalled
The build was interruptedcompile_interrupted
Our server restarted during your buildserver_restart
Our build service is unavailablecompiler_unavailable
We couldn't save the built scenestorage_write_failed
Something went wrong on our sideinternal

The scene is live but unsigned (signature_failed) needs nothing from you: the scene opens and works normally.

If the same file fails twice for a reason on our side, write to hello@ctruh.com with the file name and the message you saw.

Live tours and voice on mobile data#

A live tour works on mobile data: guests follow the host, and a phone that drops from Wi-Fi to 4G rejoins on its own.

Voice is harder on mobile data. Voices go directly from one person's phone to another's, and some mobile networks and office firewalls do not allow that. When two people cannot hear each other, the tour panel says so; the rest of the tour keeps working.

  • Put one of the two people on Wi-Fi, or on a phone hotspot.
  • If voice will not connect at all, keep touring and talk on a phone call instead.
  • Allow the microphone when the browser asks. If you said no by mistake, allow it again in the browser's site settings and rejoin voice.
  • Up to six people can talk at once; everyone else can still listen to the tour and follow along.

Privacy of links#

  • A share link is like a key. Anyone who has it can open the scene. Scenes are not listed or searchable anywhere, but a forwarded link works for whoever receives it.
  • For a scene only certain people should see, make it private and give each person their own link; you can cut one person off later without affecting the others. See Share privately.
  • A live tour link opens that tour's room for a day. Send it only to the people you want in the tour.
  • Nothing in a live tour is recorded. Voice goes between the people in the tour, not through our server. Names typed into a tour are used for that session only.
  • Viewing statistics that an owner sees count visits; they never include visitors' names or addresses.
  • Link previews in chat apps show the scene's title and picture, so pick a title you are happy for recipients to see.

Signing in#

Verse signs you in with a six-digit code by email or WhatsApp (how it works).

  • No code arrived by email: check spam, and that the address is spelled right. Ask again after 20 seconds; there is a short limit on how many codes one address can request an hour.
  • No code on WhatsApp: check the number and country, and that WhatsApp is on that phone. Use email instead.
  • "That code has expired" or "too many tries": codes last 10 minutes and five tries. Ask for a new one.
  • Signed in on the wrong device: Account → Sign-in & security → Sign out everywhere.

Still stuck?#

Ask Ask Verse, the site assistant, or write to hello@ctruh.com with the link, the device and browser you used, and what you saw.
